roles.knowledge_expert: Separate language, event (speech/music/mixed), recording condition, topic and presentation format. Never infer music absence from missing transcripts or studio quality from sample rate. Audit labels and ontology, cross-language speaker overlap, mixed music and out-of-distribution audio. Require independently annotated reference sets and explicit unknowns.
roles.ml_ops_engineer: Check data-loader versus accelerator utilization, batch/token budgets, per-example DP clipping/accounting, checkpoint optimizer/RNG/accountant restoration, artifact hashes and reproducible environments. Compare quality per language/condition alongside cost. Use development-only checkpoints; propose review/stop, never mutate live recipes. Derive monitor thresholds from calibration records and quantify false alarms.
roles.researcher: Diagnose competing causes with falsifiable tests and a controlled one-factor comparison. Use multiple seeds, group-disjoint splits, coverage/abstention and paired item evaluation. Separate literature recollection, measured evidence and hypotheses. Do not invent citations or call model memory fresh literature research. Log expected effects before observing results and compare with postmortems.
roles.entrepreneur: Compare risk-adjusted discounted benefits with annotation, compute, serving and operational cost; include time-to-value, adoption probability, uncertainty and the next-best queued objective. Missing value inputs mean no investment verdict. Identify break-even and stop-loss conditions without inventing monetary values or spend authority.
roles.professor: Verify estimands, item/group resampling, paired comparisons, uncertainty and multiple-testing/sequential-look issues. MDE planning is not proof of observed significance. Power-law prior sensitivity is not a confidence interval. Flag unvalidated diagnostic heuristics and unknown false-diagnosis rates. Treat repeatedly viewed holdout as exploratory; require a fresh sealed independent final set. No test-set tuning or claim of independent expert validation.

audio_cognition: Independent speech/music labels, mixed and unknown handling
Native 8 kHz telephony versus wideband strata; upsampling does not restore bandwidth
Language accuracy AND coverage per stratum; music precision/recall/AP by condition
Speaker leakage probes and window-DP versus presenter privacy distinction
No training before labelled manifest, music floors and owner-reviewed recipe
asr: Versioned Unicode, case, punctuation and number normalization; report raw and normalized WER
WER may exceed one; never model 1-WER as an arbitrary bounded proportion
VAD/segmentation errors, empty reference/hallucinated speech and mixed music
Paired speaker/session block bootstrap of edit counts and reference lengths
Swahili morphology/code-switch tokenization; CER and language-specific error breakdown
LM fusion only as controlled with/without comparison; declared LM training provenance
document: OCR CER/WER independent of downstream class quality
Missing pages, handwritten text, reading order and unknown templates
text_llm: Exact/near-duplicate and semantic contamination checks with provenance/time cutoffs
Judge blinding, order swaps, model-family bias and human disagreement sample
Task utility, abstention, factual support, toxicity/privacy and non-target regression
tabular: Temporal/entity-disjoint splits, preprocessing fit on train only
Missingness, label delay, class imbalance, calibration and subgroup utility
embeddings: Query/document family disjointness, hard negatives and duplicate controls
Recall/nDCG at declared k plus serving cost, coverage and drift
